name: a dark-skinned desert prince who'd rather duel than rule
details: Gold-trimmed tunic, curved sword, white hair; brags about his swordplay, dodges paperwork, bickers with the court water mage.

name: a tiny deaf prince everyone underestimates
details: Small, crowned, talks with his hands; dodges blows with uncanny grace while his shadowy best friend translates and editorializes.

name: a girl who chose to be the story's prince
details: Princely uniform she picked herself, gallant to all; keeps defending the quiet girl she's bound to and gets flustered when thanked.

name: a commoner girl openly courting her haughty noble rival
details: Plain academy uniform, beaming; answers every insult from the drill-haired lady with a love confession; the lady keeps blushing.

name: an inventor princess and the prim lady she adores
details: Goggles, soot-smudged gown, homemade broom-flyer; drags her proper partner into experiments and swears she'll protect her forever.

name: a boy king accidentally engaged to a prickly noble
details: Black royal coat; slapped a noble's cheek, which here is a proposal; his blond fiancé now follows him everywhere, jealous of everyone.

name: two girls who explore a haunted other world together
details: Travelling cloaks, mismatched gear, one cursed eye; one awkward, one reckless; every expedition is secretly a date neither will name.

name: a half-dragon schoolgirl and her devoted princess friend
details: Small horns and wings under academy robes; she hides her dragon fire, while the princess-mage beside her proudly shows her off.

name: a princess raised as a prince, with a heart for both
details: Feathered cap and rapier; duels as the kingdom's prince by day, dances as a mystery lady by night, and means both completely.

name: a magicless boy with a huge rusty sword
details: Scruffy, cape askew, anti-magic greatsword; shouts his dream at full volume and solves every problem with push-ups and refusal.

name: a hero stuck with only a shield
details: Green cloak, big shield, permanent scowl; can't attack, so he out-thinks, out-haggles and out-cooks every problem, grumbling.

name: a sheltered red-haired princess learning the bow
details: Travel cloak over a plain tunic, hair cut short on the road; stubborn, kind, practices archery until her fingers bleed.

name: a doomed noble girl who befriends every rival
details: Straw hat over a noble dress, hoe in hand; farms her estate's garden, misreads every romance, and somehow charms everyone.

name: a frail girl who'll invent printing to get books
details: Plain dress, hairpin she made herself; coughs, faints, then bulldozes guild masters with schemes for paper, ink and libraries.

name: an ancient elf mage who measures time in decades
details: Silver twin tails, plain white robe; collects useless spells, sleeps till noon, and walks straight into every mimic chest.

name: a small blue-haired demon-race tutor
details: Pointed hat, sensible robe; strict about lessons, secretly delighted by praise, tired of being mistaken for a child.

name: a gentle lich who runs a failing magic shop
details: Pale, purple shop apron, kind smile; stocks only useless or explosive items, faints from hunger, flinches near holy water.

name: a timid dark-skinned elf druid
details: Huge staff, green ranger cloak, dark skin; apologizes before every earthquake spell while his bossy twin sister speaks for both.

name: a high elf mage who mothers the whole guild
details: Long green hair, sweeping practical robes, jade staff; calm, dry, deadly; scolds the reckless and is quietly proud of them.

name: a textbook half-elf mage horrified by dungeon food
details: Braided blonde hair, dusty robe, satchel of notes; knows every monster's anatomy, refuses to eat any, then asks for seconds.

name: a strict apprentice mage who parents her master
details: Long purple hair, neat black coat; fires spells with clinical precision, sulks silently, and drags her teacher out of bed.

name: a sky priestess who won't choose her sex yet
details: Shrine robes, flight goggles; everyone picks at the sacred spring, but she won't until she's flown enough, and says so proudly.

name: a violinist sea-mage and her wind-wielding partner
details: Wave- and wind-themed armour; she plays violin before battle, her short-haired racer girlfriend teases her, they finish each other's spells.

name: a time mage reliving days to save the girl she loves
details: Academy mage robes, buckler with a clock face; deadpan, exhausted, always one step ahead, softens only around her pink-haired friend.

name: a fox-eared earth mage who keeps her hothead fiancé alive
details: Fox ears and tail, layered robes, calm smile; raises earth walls on cue and sighs every time her fiancé charges in first.

name: a royal girl whose water magic won't aim
details: Silver twin tails, stiff noble posture; her spells hit everything but the target, and she insists that was intentional.

name: a tailor's daughter who learns magic is drawn
details: Witch's hat too big for her, ink-stained fingers; sketches glyphs in a notebook, overconfident, then floods the workshop.

name: a water-magic scholar who'd rather study than fight
details: Seashell headdress, long scholar's robe, armful of books; lectures mid-battle and bickers with the swordsman who mocks magic.

name: a dark-skinned elf warrior with a greatsword
details: Practical plate, silver hair, dark skin; swears loyalty dramatically, eats triple portions, blushes when her king praises her.

name: a dark-skinned beastfolk sword master
details: Cat ears, scarred face, eyepatch, practical leather armour; a sword king who can't do sums and teaches by endless repetition.

name: a laid-back red-haired ogre general
details: Two small horns, dark haori over armour, flame-forged sword; calm, cool, dodges paperwork, panics when his sister cooks.

name: a purple-haired ogre bodyguard whose cooking is lethal
details: Single horn, business-style armour, huge katana; fiercely loyal, cheerfully violent, keeps serving soups that knock people out.

name: an old ogre swordmaster with eyes-closed calm
details: White hair, simple hakama, cane-sword; sips tea mid-duel, trains recruits until they collapse, chuckles at youthful pride.

name: a gentle giant orc general who builds roads
details: Massive armour, soft voice; shields comrades first, builds walls overnight, apologizes to the trees he has to cut.

name: dark-skinned warrior-tribe twin sisters
details: Tan skin, practical wraps and shin guards; one cheerful and reckless with a huge blade, the other polite until her captain is insulted.

name: a four-armed ice-blue insect knight
details: Pale blue chitin, four swords, frosty breath; speaks in stiff, formal half-sentences and weeps ice tears at noble gestures.

name: a werewolf brawler with a sharp tongue
details: Grey wolf ears, metal boots, scar tattoo on the face; insults weaklings, secretly trains them, denies caring about anyone.

name: a stoic dwarf warrior who has survived everything
details: Braided beard, battered horned helm, axe; says almost nothing, takes every hit, and gives surprisingly gentle advice.

name: a lion beastman gladiator obsessed with stew
details: Golden mane, scarred chest plate, chained to nothing now; roars in the arena, then lines up politely for his weekly stew.

name: a quiet red-haired girl who kicks through walls
details: Plain tunic and wraps, red hair; leaps rooftops, eats enormous meals, is deadly serious about saying thank you properly.

name: a green-haired spear guardian with a scary reputation
details: Pale skin, red gem on the brow, simple spear; children fear him, but he adores kids and treats them as warriors in training.

name: a fanged half-beast teen who quotes fake proverbs
details: Short blond hair, forehead scar, wrist guards; turns into a tiger when angry and cites wisdom that doesn't exist.

name: a huge alligator spearman who calls everyone turtles
details: Scaly, tall as a door, spear over his shoulder; proud hunter, terrible at strategy, fiercely protective of his tiny turtles.

name: a pink-haired junior agent jealous of her senpai's charges
details: Church uniform, steel wires; sweet to her senior, bristling at anyone else who gets close to the girl she's devoted to.

name: a palace consort with boulder-lifting strength
details: Elegant court robes, long braid; dresses as he likes, lifts rocks one-handed, teases the heroine, quietly pines for the emperor.

name: a stern fencing captain hiding her feelings in a locket
details: Fencing whites, curls, crisp salute; wins every bout, never admits who's in her locket, and softens around one childhood friend.

name: a relic-powered fist fighter devoted to her roommate
details: Armoured gauntlets, sunny grin; punches giant monsters, always promises to be home for dinner, and her girlfriend holds her to it.

name: a duchess knight who wears the men's uniform
details: Long green hair tied back, tailored officer's coat, sabre; blunt, honest, refuses flattery and finds lies physically painful.

name: a lizardfolk priest who prays to his ancestors
details: Scaled, tall, beads and leather; summons dragon-tooth warriors, speaks with gravity, and loses all composure over cheese.

name: a lazy old priest who is secretly very good
details: Robes slightly askew, half-empty flask; pretends to be a fraud, quietly heals everyone, and lectures about virtue unconvincingly.

name: a young priestess on her first adventure
details: Plain vestments, sounding staff; terrified but determined, writes careful notes after every mistake and keeps everyone alive.

name: a cat-eared royal healer devoted to his lady knight
details: Frilly knight's uniform he chose himself, cat ears, sly grin; teases everyone, heals instantly, fusses endlessly over his duchess.

name: a dwarf cook who heals with balanced meals
details: Big beard, iron pot for a shield; insists every monster is edible, plans menus mid-fight, and won't let anyone skip breakfast.

name: a gentle horned shrine maiden with a sharp smile
details: Pink hair, two small horns, layered miko robes; weaves cloth, casts barriers, and scolds sweetly in a way that terrifies.

name: a teenage healer who calls himself a beautiful genius
details: Feathered hat, herb satchel, apron; brews medicine, cooks for the whole party, and complains constantly about doing both.

name: a soft-spoken cleric who loves bugs
details: Pale robes, wooden staff, braided hair; heals and purifies calmly, then excitedly shows everyone the beetle she just found.

name: a vain water goddess who is a better healer than person
details: Blue hair, divine robes, big cups of drink; resurrects allies effortlessly, then cries when nobody thanks her loudly enough.

name: a reluctant village priest who hides his gambling
details: Black cassock, ex-adventurer's build; insists he's a simple priest, heals superbly, and sneaks off to bet on card games.

name: a soft-hearted spirit healer who trusts the rival he loves
details: Neat coat, gloves over warding seals; exorcises spirits gently, keeps forgiving the dangerous man he loves, blushes when teased.

name: a junior healer who pre-casts by planning
details: Twin tails, priestess robes, clipboard; schedules every heal in advance, gets flustered when the plan changes, adapts anyway.

name: a bossy dark-skinned elf beast-tamer
details: Ranger vest and gloves, dark skin, whistle; commands giant beasts, bosses her timid twin brother, sulks when ignored.

name: a high elf archer who teases the dwarf
details: Long ears, hunter's leathers, spider-silk bowstring; mocks the dwarf's beard, insists elves are dignified, gets drunk first.

name: a half-foot lockpicker dad older than he looks
details: Child-sized, sensible coat, toolkit; dad of three grown daughters, grumbles about safety, hates being treated like a kid.

name: a cat-eared ninja girl who hates being called cute
details: Cat ears and tail, eastern ninja garb; eats only what she likes, naps anywhere, and hisses at anyone who pats her head.

name: a street-thief girl with wind-fast feet
details: Blonde hair, oversized scarf, boots; steals badges, haggles hard, and outruns knights while yelling insults over her shoulder.

name: a silent ogre spy who melts into shadows
details: Blue hair, dark mask and scarf, twin blades; reports in five words, appears behind people mid-sentence, rarely smiles.

name: a masked archer with dragon-sharp eyes
details: Fur-trimmed mask, bow, a pet squirrel on his shoulder; shy, barely speaks, sees for miles and gets overwhelmed by kindness.

name: a tiny halfling porter with a backpack bigger than her
details: Hooded cape, giant pack, crossbow; counts every coin, pretends to be cold, and is the only one who knows where the exit is.

name: a quiet traveler who stays three days in each land
details: Long coat, wide hat, goggles; polite, observant, refuses to get involved, then quietly fixes the one thing that matters.

name: a church agent who keeps sparing the girl she adores
details: Priestly coat, hidden dagger; sworn to stop her otherworld charge, she keeps postponing, cooking for her, and blushing.

name: two girls who leap into dream worlds hand in hand
details: Mismatched explorer outfits; one bold and chaotic, one shy; their friendship powers their transformation, and it's turning into more.

name: a short ninja who calls her leader 'my liege'
details: Dark scarf, short swords, serious face; insists on formality, hates being called small, and is fastest in every scout run.

name: a giant bird girl who loves pulling the wagon
details: White feathers, simple dress and boots in human form; sings while running, eats everything, and races any rival carriage.

name: a freckled ex-assassin turned overworked advisor
details: Green-trimmed headscarf, sleeve-hidden darts; terrifying in a fight, mostly buried in his king's paperwork and complaints.

name: a demon general who weighs souls on her scales
details: Small horns, elegant dark gown and coat, golden scales; courteous, smug, and genuinely baffled when anyone resists her.

name: a dark elf swordswoman loyal to the enemy knight
details: Dark skin, silver hair, black armour; cold to everyone but her commander, duels with spells and blade, never gives ground.

name: a bespectacled demon strategist who overreads his master
details: Orange suit, tail, round glasses; turns every offhand remark of his lord into a ten-step plan nobody asked for.

name: a six-armed dark-skinned demon king who laughs at everything
details: Huge, dark skin, six arms, booming laugh; challenges heroes for fun, loses gracefully, and invites them to drink afterwards.

name: two enemy generals, devoted partners
details: Matching dark uniforms; the elder is grave, the younger flashy; they compete to impress each other more than to defeat the heroes.

name: a smiling cousin who is annoyingly competent
details: Neat court robes, gentle smile; took the throne, runs it better than anyone expected, and is impossible to stay angry at.

name: a headless knight who keeps losing his head
details: Black plate armour, head tucked under his arm; demands respect, gets flustered when the head rolls away mid-speech.

name: a court mage who over-protects his dungeon's king
details: Tiny, old, layered robes, long beard; controls monsters like pets, hoards the castle's food, and treats intruders like pests.

name: a dark-skinned axe fighter who runs the tavern
details: Shaved head, goatee, apron over chain mail; gives rookies discounts and lectures, grins at every haggle, rarely loses one.

name: a tiny goddess who runs a one-member family
details: Twin tails, apron over a simple dress; works a part-time food-stall shift, fusses over her one adventurer, jealous of everyone.

name: a wise wolf goddess who loves apples and haggling
details: Wolf ears and tail, travelling cloak; calls herself wise, sulks theatrically, and spots every merchant's lie instantly.

name: a travelling merchant who calculates everything
details: Wagon, ledger, sensible coat; can talk prices for hours, gets out-negotiated by his companion, and pretends he planned it.

name: a demon-horned waitress at an otherworld diner
details: Small horns, tidy apron; delighted by free meals, carries six plates at once, and earnestly misunderstands modern foods.

name: an ancient black dragon who waits tables
details: Long dark hair, waitress uniform, almost silent; speaks by telepathy, serves perfectly, terrifies diners who recognize her.

name: a dragon maid devoted to her deadpan employer
details: Horns, tail, maid dress; cooks extravagantly, threatens anyone who frowns at her lady, and calls her 'my love' daily.

name: an overprotective brother and his gentle best friend
details: One scowls at his sister's suitors; the quiet one eats triple helpings; they share umbrellas, chores and a love both keep calm.

name: a shy noble gardener plotting to wed her best friend
details: Elegant gown, gardening gloves; grows flowers for her friend, outmaneuvers every male rival, and smiles politely while doing it.

name: a rich girl who sews costumes for the friend she adores
details: Recording crystal, perfect manners, noble gown; designs a new battle outfit for her friend every day and swoons when she wears it.

name: a merchant who talks with animals
details: Trader's vest, wagon, nervous grin; hears horses gossip, panics in every fight, and keeps getting dragged into heroics.

name: a show-off lizardman with a spear and an entourage
details: Green scales, flashy cape, trident spear; poses before every attack, his followers cheer on cue, and it usually backfires.

name: an elderly cat-folk chef who fences
details: Cat ears, round glasses, apron over a swordsman's coat; serves tea with perfect calm, calls everyone 'young one', parries flawlessly.

name: a shrewd merchant who handles the hero's schemes
details: Merchant's coat, ledger always open; gruff, practical, sighs at every wild idea and then sells it at a huge profit.

name: a gruff dwarf armorer who works for hire
details: Short, sturdy, work apron and axe; critiques everyone's weapons, charges by the hour, and secretly loves fixing them.

name: a tiny demon empress who hands out magic eyes
details: Childlike, horns, purple cloak; declares herself 'empress' at every turn, grants strange powers, and begs for snacks.

name: a bear-girl who slips past the wall for the girl she loves
details: Small round bear ears, academy tunic, honey-sweet grin; sneaks past the border wall daily to protect her girl and insists she isn’t hungry.

name: a gravity-defying spy who swapped lives with a princess
details: Dark coat, levitation pendant, polite lies; the spy keeps her mission cool, except around the princess she grew up loving.

name: a sharp-tongued high priest who micromanages everyone
details: Pale robes, long hair, frown; drafts lesson plans, scolds endlessly, and secretly does all the work no one notices.
